data.title: Ellington House IV
data.about:
Ellington House IV is a new residential complex from the developer Ellington Properties. Located in one of the most picturesque areas of Dubai Hills, the complex creates a comfortable living space surrounded by nature and superb views. 

The project stands out for its special and unique architecture, in which the features of minimalism, modern style and organic design can be traced. The 12-storey building's façade framing balconies offer breathtaking views of the surrounding area and the finest views of the Dubai Hills.
